version: DRAFT — sample wording. Replace every source_text with the exact sentences from the official campus guide before the demo.

rules.source_text: Plastic bottles (PET) go in the blue Dry Waste bin. Empty them, crush them and keep the cap on.
Aluminium drink cans go in the blue Dry Waste bin. Empty, rinse if sticky, and flatten.
Newspapers and clean office paper go in the blue Dry Waste bin. Keep paper dry and fold it flat.

preparation: Remove tape and labels where possible
rules.source_text: Clean cardboard boxes go in the blue Dry Waste bin. Remove tape where possible and flatten them.

preparation: Place gently in the bin — do not break
rules.source_text: Unbroken glass bottles and jars go in the blue Dry Waste bin. Empty, rinse, remove the cap and place them gently.
Milk and juice cartons (Tetra Pak) go in the blue Dry Waste bin. Empty, rinse and flatten them.

preparation: Remove the plastic lid and put it in the blue bin separately
rules.source_text: Plain, uncoated paper cups go in the blue Dry Waste bin once empty. Remove plastic lids.
Pizza boxes with no grease or food go in the blue Dry Waste bin. Flatten them first.
Chips packets and other multi-layer snack wrappers go in the blue Dry Waste bin. Empty out crumbs first.
Rigid plastic food containers go in the blue Dry Waste bin. Scrape out food and rinse them first.
Clean plastic carry bags go in the blue Dry Waste bin. Bundle them together.

preparation: Empty leftover food into the green bin
rules.source_text: Takeaway containers go in the blue Dry Waste bin after leftover food is emptied into the green bin.

preparation: Make sure they are clean and dry
rules.source_text: Clean, dry old clothes and textiles go in the blue Dry Waste bin, tied in a bundle.

preparation: Put it in the bin without any plastic bag
rules.source_text: Fruit and vegetable peels go in the green Wet Waste bin. Do not use plastic bags.
Eggshells go in the green Wet Waste bin. Crushing them helps composting.

preparation: Tear off any clean part and put it in the blue bin
rules.source_text: Greasy or food-soiled cardboard, such as an oily pizza box, goes in the green Wet Waste bin, torn into pieces.

preparation: Wrap it in newspaper or thick paper
Hand to housekeeping or place in the red bin
rules.source_text: Broken glass is hazardous. Wrap it in paper, mark it "SHARP" and place it in the red bin or hand it to housekeeping.

preparation: Do not puncture or crush it
rules.source_text: Aerosol and spray cans go in the red Hazardous Waste bin. Make sure they are empty and never puncture them.

preparation: Put it straight in the grey bin
rules.source_text: Used tissues, napkins and wet wipes go in the grey Reject bin.

preparation: Remove the plastic lid and put it in the blue bin
rules.source_text: Paper cups with a plastic or wax lining cannot be recycled with paper. Empty them and put them in the grey Reject bin.

preparation: Drop it in the e-waste box at the library entrance
rules.source_text: Batteries are e-waste. Tape the terminals and drop them in the e-waste box at the library entrance.

preparation: Hand it to housekeeping or the e-waste box
rules.source_text: Light bulbs and tube lights are e-waste. Do not break them; hand them to housekeeping or use the e-waste box.
